_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_sph#6, whose advice execution showed to be incomplete in a way that makes it useless as written. In 4C, BACKGROUNDPRESSURE is read only inside the transport-velocity branch of SPHMomentum, so with TRANSPORTVELOCITYFORMULATION at its NoTransportVelocity default — which is where the upstream free-surface deck leaves it — the value is never touched. Four arms on particle_sph_1d_hydrostatic_freesurface_densityintegration_cubicspline_adami.4C.yaml: BACKGROUNDPRESSURE 0.005 alone reproduces the baseline's five result-test verdicts to the last printed digit; StandardTransportVelocity with BACKGROUNDPRESSURE 0 likewise; only both together move the answer (density 1.00015521027962739 -> 9.76678137259415213e-01, three of five tests fail). An agent that sets BACKGROUNDPRESSURE > 0 on a free-surface deck and moves on has changed nothing and will believe the tensile instability is handled. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: take away the BACKGROUNDPRESSURE half of the combination arm. BOTH then coincides with TV, its verdicts become identical to the baseline, BOTH_FAILURES drops to 0 and the fixture must go red.

give the BACKGROUNDPRESSURE-only arm a transport velocity as well, so it is no longer isolating the parameter. BGP then stops matching the baseline and BGP_VERDICTS_IDENTICAL_TO_BASE flips to no — the fixture must go red.
